verdict.rationale: Sumsub is a KYC/verification SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant runtime; the evidence only shows Sumsub exposing its own MCP server for other agents to consume (docs-4, probe-3), which is the reverse role from 'plugging MCP servers into this product.' There is no agentic client capability in Sumsub itself that could consume external MCP servers, making this axis a category error for this product type.
